meta.name: address-github-comments
meta.description: Use when you need to address review or issue comments on an open GitHub Pull Request using the gh CLI.

copy.tagline: 用 gh CLI 处理 GitHub PR 上的评审意见
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在命令行回复 GitHub PR 评论
copy.tagline_en: Address GitHub PR review comments using gh CLI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to reply to GitHub PR comments from the command line

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用 GitHub CLI 查看、分类并逐一处理 Pull Request 上的评审意见或 Issue 反馈，等待你确认后再修改代码并回复已解决。
howto.when: 当你打开一个 GitHub Pull Request 并需要处理上面的评审意见或 Issue 评论时触发。

say.text: 帮我处理这个 PR 上的所有评论。
say.note: Claude 会拉取评论并列出修改计划。

say.text: 先处理第一条评论的修改。
say.note: Claude 会等待你确认后应用修改。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the GitHub CLI to fetch, categorize, and systematically address review comments or issue feedback on a Pull Request, waiting for your confirmation before applying code changes and replying as resolved.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you open a GitHub Pull Request and need to address review comments or issue feedback on it.

say_en.text: Help me address all comments on this PR.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch comments and list a plan.

say_en.text: Start with the first comment's fix.
say_en.note: Claude will wait for your confirmation before applying.
